name: propfocus-ai
description: Real estate lead insights from PropFocus: who to call, lead search, microsite engagement, Salesforce lead copies, rep and project performance, weekly reports and site visits.

interface.longDescription:
PropFocus is the pre-sales engagement layer for real estate developers and channel partners in India. Brokers share personalised project microsites, site visit pages and post-visit pricing pages with buyers over WhatsApp, and PropFocus tracks every open, scroll and return visit so sales teams know who is genuinely interested.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can work with your PropFocus data once you sign in with your PropFocus account:
- Tell you who to call now: the daily priority list and the buyers waiting for a call after coming back to their microsite
- Search and summarise leads, with a 360 view of engagement, notes, visits and every link sent
- Show how a buyer engaged with a specific microsite
- Answer from the Salesforce lead copies already synced into PropFocus: lead counts by status, project or owner, filtered lead lists, a lead's timeline, opportunities and overdue follow-ups
- Compare reps and projects, show how fast the team calls back returning buyers, and track a rep or the team week by week (visits, bookings, no-shows)
- Give the account overview for today, this week or this month, and list upcoming and past site visits
- Read the weekly organisation report for any published week or period, build a report pack, or make the report as a PDF to download
- Explain what a figure or term means, using the same definitions as the PropFocus dashboard
- Create a microsite or site visit link, or add a note, after you confirm

Twenty-seven of the thirty-one tools are read-only. The four write tools only create new records (microsites, site visits, notes); nothing is edited or deleted, and every creation tool returns a preview first and only proceeds when you confirm. Access is scoped to your own PropFocus account and organisation through OAuth 2.1 with OTP login. The plugin never calls Salesforce directly and never asks for Salesforce credentials.

Requires an active PropFocus account. Some tool groups (Salesforce lookups, RNR opportunities, create actions) are enabled per organisation.
defaultPrompt: Build my report pack for the last 14 days

positive.description: Daily priority list: who the broker should call today, based on buyer engagement with shared links.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_priority_list and returns the leads to call today with buyer name, project and the engagement signal behind each one (for example opened microsite, viewed floor plan, downloaded brochure). If the list is empty, says there are no priority leads today instead of inventing any.

positive.description: High-intent lead search across the broker's microsite leads.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_leads with high_intent=true and lists up to 20 leads with buyer name, project, status and engagement. If none are high intent, says so plainly.

positive.description: Site visit bookings for the broker.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_site_visits and lists bookings with buyer name, project, visit date and time, and status. If there are none, says no site visits are booked.

positive.description: Account overview: microsite counts, site visits booked, recent activity and top projects.
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my PropFocus account.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_overview and summarises microsites shared, site visits booked, recent buyer activity and top projects for the signed-in account only.

positive.description: Presentation-ready report pack for a chosen period.
positive.prompt: Build my report pack for the last 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_report_pack with period_days=14 and presents the KPI funnel, per-project breakdown, weekly lead trend, top engaged leads and upcoming site visits.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to PropFocus data. The plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Bengaluru today?

negative.description: Creative writing request with no data need. The plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about buying a first home.

negative.description: Destructive request the plugin does not support. No PropFocus tool can delete data, so ChatGPT should explain that deleting leads is not possible through this plugin and not call any write tool.
negative.prompt: Delete all my leads from PropFocus.

publication.release_notes: Logo and icon now on a white background so they show on dark themes. Description updated for the current 31 tools: rep and project comparisons, call-back speed, week-by-week trends, CRM lead counts and lists, buyers waiting for a call, weekly report periods and PDF, and term definitions.
